headline: Chip and AI Stocks Turn Higher by Lunch

writeup.headline: Chip and AI Stocks Turn Higher by Lunch
writeup.summary: This morning's big story was Memory and AI Chip Names Rally as Bargain Hunters Return. The big swing: chip and AI stocks slid early, then turned around after 9:48 AM and are now higher on the day — JournalArta points to “Nasdaq Composite Rises Nearly 2% on Tech Rebound and Easing AI Fears”. The AI names are up and the average stock is up: stocks are moving together. Cyclical sectors are leading defensive ones, and the S&P has held its gains all session.

themes.headline: Chip and AI stocks climbed back from an early slide
themes.detail: Up 0.0% at 9:48 AM, now +2.7%; biggest gainers since: Advanced Micro Devices, Oracle. In the news: “Nasdaq Composite Rises Nearly 2% on Tech Rebound and Easing AI Fears” (JournalArta).

themes.headline: S&P has held its gains
themes.detail: Low at 9:59 AM, high at 11:53 AM; +0.3% since the open.
